original_description: The Persephone Collection travels through the seasons, balancing a dark, regal mood with the triumphant bloom of new life. Here a small pink round, a faceted ruby rondelle in deep magenta and a bright peridot bead stack above a plump peacock freshwater pearl drop. Gold filled wire and gold filled ear wires hold it together, lead and nickel free, at 1.5 inches long. Small enough for the office, with enough color to carry into dinner afterward.

original_description: Symbolic, colorful and rooted in connection, the Love One Another Collection is designed to be a daily reminder of love and togetherness. A small matte gold plated brass hoop, nickel and lead safe, holds a cluster of round lapis beads wired around a faceted lapis shield drop, its gold-flecked deep blue shown off by a hand-wrapped brass cap. Antique brass ear wires carry the 1.5" drop. Their saturated blue is a natural match for white linen, camel wool or a chambray shirt dress.

name: Mauve Mix Czech Glass Bird Dangle Earrings
original_description: Mauve Mix is a vintage-inspired palette of dusky rose, plum and patina, finished in warm antique brass. A small copper-toned bird perches above a faceted teal Czech glass bead, which sits under an ornate brass petal cap so it reads like a tiny bell flower. The pair measures about 2 inches on antique brass ear wires, nickel and lead safe. Pull them on with a rust cardigan and a floral midi skirt on a cool autumn afternoon.
